name: Regorafenib (single-agent oral multikinase inhibitor)
cyclesNote: Second-line after tolerated progression on sorafenib. 160 mg once daily for the first 3 weeks of each 4-week cycle (days 1 to 21), then 1 week off (days 22 to 28). Repeat until progression or unacceptable toxicity.

institution.provenance: ONCQIS grounded Standard Protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: Hand-foot skin reaction: prophylactic skin care and dose-modify per labeling (highest incidence in the first cycle).
Blood pressure control; monitor liver function closely (risk of severe hepatotoxicity).
monitoring: liver function tests (frequent, especially first 2 months - hepatotoxicity risk)
blood pressure at baseline and during therapy

doseModificationRules.condition: grade 2-3 hand-foot skin reaction or other significant toxicity
doseModificationRules.text: Interrupt and dose-reduce stepwise (e.g. to 120 mg then 80 mg once daily) per labeling; clinical review.
Hold for hepatotoxicity and reassess per labeling; clinical review required.

drugs.name: Regorafenib
drugs.notes: Regorafenib 160 mg PO once daily on days 1 to 21 of a 28-day cycle (3 weeks on, 1 week off). Second-line oral multikinase inhibitor for advanced HCC after tolerated progression on sorafenib, Child-Pugh A. Authored from standard practice (NCCN Hepatocellular Carcinoma; RESORCE supporting evidence).
drugs.frequency: once daily (3 weeks on, 1 week off)
